description: Is this token safe? Rug check for any token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: a 0-100 risk score with plain reasons (mint, freeze, blacklist, fee, pause or trading-switch powers, upgradeable code, holder concentration, thin liquidity, a deployer whose earlier tokens lost their liquidity), the facts behind it, and USD price and liquidity. A fingerprint sent back as since returns what changed. Rules-based, not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

chain.description: Chain the token is on; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

since.description: watch.fingerprint from an earlier call; adds what changed since then

name: token_risk_check
